meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order with extremely large price value is accepted

plan.title: Recreate Order with Extremely Large Price

steps.note: Open the API-prepared awarded event summary without creating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ stage's Recreate Order window from Settings.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order window, click Edit More Details, replace the Price* field with 9999999999.99, click Create Order, verify the window closes, and stop when the new order creation result is shown

steps.note: Perform the buyer-side form interaction that has no dedicated catalog step, including the large price value and order creation.
Assert the expected success confirmation after creating the order.
